instruction: Reply just to Alex on the migration timeline email: thanks, we'll confirm the cutover date by Friday.
final_text:
I replied to Alex Moreno in the "Migration timeline" thread, and the email went only to him:

> Hi Alex,
> Thanks — we'll confirm the cutover date by Friday.
> Best,
> Sam

For context, Alex's email proposes switching over to the new Brightline workspace on Oct 15, with a practice run on Oct 8. His email opens with "Hi all," so others may have been meant to see it, but only he got your reply.
